description_en: Registers and authorizes a device-side SDK
kebab_example: aliyun moguan-sdk register-device --app-key NWTtS623eqo6s070 --sdk-code SDKCodeTest01 --device-id 99daf4a623f2b623ae08e79d6d4bf686 --user-device-id D001 --extend key=example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: RegisterDevice

parameters.help_en: The appKey required for device-side SDK authorization. After you log on to the SDK Authorization Center customer platform with your Alibaba Cloud account and allocate or create a new batch for issued authorizations, you obtain this appKey
parameters.help_zh: 端侧SDK授权时必填的appKey信息：用户使用阿里云账号登陆SDK授权中心客户平台后，对已发放授权进行分配和新建批次后，会得到此appKey
parameters.name: app_key

parameters.help_en: The SDKCode required for device-side SDK authorization. Each issued SDK authorization has a unique SDKCode. After you log on to the SDK Authorization Center customer platform, you can obtain this information from the authorization list
parameters.help_zh: 端侧SDK授权时必填的SDKCode信息：每个发放的SDK授权都会有唯一的SDKCode信息，登录SDK授权中心客户平台后，可在授权列表获得此信息
parameters.name: sdk_code

parameters.help_en: The DeviceId required for device-side SDK authorization. This is the unique identifier of the device, generated during device-side development integration. It must be unique and immutable
parameters.help_zh: 端侧SDK授权时必填的DeviceId信息：设备的唯一标识，设备端开发接入时生成，需保证唯一且不变
parameters.name: device_id

parameters.help_en: The user-specified ID that serves as a unique identifier for the authorized device. This helps you manage and track authorized devices and can be used to troubleshoot authorization issues on the user side
parameters.help_zh: 用户填写的id信息，方便用户管理和记录的授权设备唯一标识，后续可用于排查用户侧授权出现的问题
parameters.name: user_device_id

parameters.help_en: The additional extension information in JSON format for future parameter expansion
parameters.help_zh: 其他扩展信息，JSON结构，方便后续扩展参数
parameters.name: extend

Data.description_en: The data returned by the device-side authorization

License.description_en: The encrypted authorization information issued by the cloud
License.description_zh: 云端下发的加密后的授权信息

PublicKey.description_en: The public key associated with the customer account
PublicKey.description_zh: 客户账户对应的公钥信息

Rid.description_en: The identifier for each authorization record of the user device-side SDK
Rid.description_zh: 用户端侧SDK每一次授权记录标识

Signature.description_en: The signature generated from the authorization information issued by the cloud
Signature.description_zh: 云端下发的授权信息加签后的结果

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the authorization API call succeeds or fails
ErrorCode.description_zh: 授权接口调用成功或失败的错误码

ErrorMessage.description_en: The result of the authorization API call

Message.description_en: Indicates whether the authorization API call is successful
Message.description_zh: 授权接口调用是否成功

RequestId.description_en: The request ID of the authorization request
